Title: Generally available: Functions now supports .NET 7 in an isolated worker process

Body.Content:
You can now build your serverless applications with .NET 7 runtime when running in the isolated process mode in Azure Functions v4. Apps built using this capability follow the same patterns as previous .NET versions in an isolated worker model in Functions. 

Share your feedback and use cases at the Azure Functions .NET language worker Github repository.

This feature is available for all Windows-based plans, Linux dedicated, and premium plans as well as Linux consumption plan.

Start to build your serverless applications with .NET 7, see the official documentation.

Learn more.
